newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian paper firm makes higher profit.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian paper firm makes higher profit.

text.p: Rakta/General Paper Industry made net after-tax profits of 35.7 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, compared to 34.8 million in the previous year, sources close to the company said on Monday. The year ended on June 30.
The profits are equivalent to 4.10 pounds for each of the 8.695 million shares issued. The shares were trading at around 25.00 pounds on Monday.
The board has proposed a free issue of one share for four for all those who hold shares on December 5, they said.
The company paid a dividend of 1.00 pound for 1994/5 but it has not mentioned a dividend for 1995/6.
The free shares will increase the capital of the company to 21.738 million pounds from 17.39 million.
Sales by the company were hard hit during the year by a Ministry of Education decision to buy from other companies and by stiff competition from imported paper, the sources said.
The majority shareholder in the company is the state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries.
